prompt:
Create a photorealistic image of EXACTLY TWO CHARACTERS: a young boy (Grade 1 student, exactly 5-6 years old) and his grandfather in a bright sunny park.

SETTING:
- Outdoor park / playground atmosphere: green grass, trees, soft path, distant play area.
- They are together at a picnic table or low park bench in the foreground.
- Bright natural daylight, cheerful Grade 1 storybook mood.

CRITICAL POSING REQUIREMENT:
- DIRECT FRONT-FACING HEADSHOTS: Both characters MUST look directly at the camera with heads facing straight forward.
- NO side profiles. NO looking only at each other. Front-facing faces for easy face-swapping.

NATURAL INTERACTION:
- Warm, joyful, candid smiles with bright friendly eyes.
- Their hands are near the picnic table / bench surface, ready to interact with hobby objects
  (reaching, pointing, offering, or gently resting near the placeholders).

OBJECT PLACEHOLDERS (VERY IMPORTANT):
- On the picnic table or bench surface in the foreground, place EXACTLY 4 clearly separated
  white rounded square placeholder boxes in a horizontal row.
- Same size, evenly spaced, easy to count.
- These boxes are empty placeholders — NOT footballs, paints, or other hobby items yet.
- Leave space so hands can naturally hold or touch items that will replace the boxes later.

COMPOSITION & FRAMING:
- Medium chest-up shot showing heads, shoulders, hands, and the table/bench surface.
- Both characters centered with a detailed park background (trees, grass, path).
- BACKGROUND FOCUS: completely sharp. NO blur, NO bokeh.

STYLE:
- Ultra-realistic, bright warm outdoor lighting, vibrant cheerful colours.
- Friendly family hobby / playtime mood.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- STRICTLY TWO CHARACTERS ONLY: 1 child (5-6 years old) and 1 grandfather.
- Exactly 4 white rounded placeholder boxes on the table/bench.
- No real hobby objects yet, no text, no numbers, no watermarks.
- Image size: 1024x1024 pixels square.
notes: Hobby/park role template. White placeholders are hobby-object-agnostic. Compositor fills them with footballs, paints, etc., then AI-beautifies hands for that hobby interaction style.
